cart.purpose: Own long-lived cart intent before an active checkout session starts.
cart.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

sessions.purpose: Own checkout session lifecycle, review state, selected shipping, and orchestration status.
sessions.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

request-support.purpose: Provide checkout request API clients and request-time Ordering/Payments orchestration adapters used by checkout sessions and external purchase-intent entry points.
request-support.allowedWhen: Allowed for route/server request adapters and cross-context server-surface orchestration that cannot live inside a feature folder.
request-support.justification: request-support centralizes context-local request client composition and the Checkout-owned confirmation adapter into Ordering and Payments.
request-support.createdFor: checkout routes, Discovery purchase-intent forms, and checkout confirmation that need authenticated API calls.
request-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when route modules no longer share request client behavior.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide checkout runtime composition and schema assembly.
runtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
runtime-support.justification: runtime-support centralizes context-local service and schema composition.
runtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when runtime composition can be generated.

seed-support.purpose: Publish deterministic checkout seed ids for development/demo data.
seed-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only for stable seed identifiers shared by tests and composition seed orchestration.
seed-support.justification: seed-support names deterministic checkout session ids without putting demo state in Ordering.
seed-support.createdFor: checkout-owned cart and started-session development data.
seed-support.sunsetWhen: Remove if seed ids become generated by a central lifecycle tool.

routes.purpose: Expose checkout-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
